snapshot.title: Time Jump: 10:00 — Recovery Phase Initiation

fields.narration: Facilitator → All: It is now 10:00. The FBI has confirmed site security, the Water Quality Manager has submitted the formal report, and the SCADA / IT Security Manager has discovered a critical gap in the PLC backup. The Control Room must now begin re-screening for manual operation, and the Incident Commander must decide whether to declare an all-clear. The shift cannot afford delays.
worldState: The FBI has confirmed the site is secure and evidence is preserved under chain of custody.
The lab has submitted the formal report for MDWS-ERP-2026 Section 13; all findings are filed under ERP-3.

The SCADA / IT Security Manager has confirmed that the most recent PLC-02 program backup (from 03/2025) does not include the 08/2025 chemical-feed logic change. Re-commissioning requires on-site support from Kessler Controls.
The Control Room is now responsible for verifying system status per ERP Section 9.1.
The Incident Commander has full authority to initiate the return-to-service checklist under MDWS-ERP-2026 Section 13.
